issues.title: Reader pending progress could be lost during recovery
issues.reproduction: Recover equal/lower pending positions, fail replacement persistence, or race a foreign record update
issues.change: Merge complete pending states, preserve winning positional tuple, publish replacement before removing unchanged sources

issues.title: Reader lifecycle/conflict saves used inconsistent baselines
issues.reproduction: Hide/close with an in-flight save, or discard a conflict already covered by remote state
issues.change: Normal/lifecycle reconciliation share high-water state; include in-flight operation and advance acknowledged revision

issues.title: Video replacement and delayed progress crossed playback sessions
issues.reproduction: Switch edition/file with delayed save or failed completion
issues.change: Key media sessions, serialize writes within a session, retain unacknowledged completion
issues.limits: Durable offline media queue and content-order generations remain separate open work

issues.title: Reset progress remained visible in discovery
issues.reproduction: Reset through ABS, then query resume/library/search/Next Up and another user
issues.change: Filter reset tombstones from discovery while preserving baseline revision reads

issues.title: Library browsing truncated large collections or applied stale pages
issues.reproduction: Browse more than 200 works; change sort/library while pages are pending
issues.change: Explicit bounded pages with stable ties, scoped child queries, cancellation, retry and honest loaded counts
issues.limits: Offset pages are not a snapshot under concurrent scans/deletes

issues.title: Cross-library grouping changed the physical serving root
issues.reproduction: Move/merge editions into a work in a different library
issues.change: Reject cross-library moves in the transaction; create new targets atomically
issues.limits: Containment only; existing wrong-root/collapsed rows and full source migration remain open

issues.title: Audio queue replacement reused the old media session
issues.reproduction: Replace ordered file IDs at same queue index or emit detached completion
issues.change: Key by ordered file IDs; save through original callback and ignore detached events
issues.limits: Metadata-only rerenders preserve playback

issues.title: Scan observer followed stale/newest jobs or overlapped requests
issues.reproduction: 409 start, superseded observer, transient 408/429/5xx or stalled body
issues.change: Pin accepted job ID, use generations and serial deadline-bounded retry

issues.title: OPML UI reported synchronous counts for asynchronous work
issues.reproduction: Import OPML; close/reopen while running; lose server status
issues.change: Follow status until done, resume existing job, prevent duplicate starts and refresh subscriptions
issues.limits: Server import status is still in-memory and can be lost on restart

issues.title: Local aggregate gate omitted frontend tests; embedding depended on prior build
issues.reproduction: Run make test from a fresh source checkout
issues.change: Build locked frontend assets before Go and execute frontend test suite in make test

issues.title: Audiobooks ignored disc/track tags
issues.reproduction: Filename order a/b/z conflicts with positive disc/track order z/b/a
issues.change: Apply disc/track tags (including N/total); natural fallback; one-time legacy repair preserving existing IDs and metadata, recomputing cumulative resume from same-edition file+offset and advancing changed revisions without changing activity timestamps
issues.limits: Order-changing rescans require playback pause/reload; already-collapsed groups are not silently split

issues.title: Warm audio scans missed covers on tag-named works
issues.reproduction: Embedded album differs from folder; add cover.jpg after first scan
issues.change: Resolve existing work ownership through persisted file rows

issues.title: ABS optional podcast metadata fallback failed
issues.reproduction: Remove podcasts table or itunesAuthor column from synthetic source DB
issues.change: Keep fallback SELECT projection aligned with Scan

issues.title: ABS podcast episodes joined on the wrong ID
issues.reproduction: libraryItems.id=2, mediaId=42, podcastEpisodes.podcastId=42
issues.change: Use media ID for the podcast episode collection

issues.title: ABS progress durations collided between media types
issues.reproduction: Book and episode share ID 1 but durations differ
issues.change: Scope duration maps by media type and ID

issues.title: Unnumbered imported podcast episodes collapsed into one edition
issues.reproduction: Import distinct episodes with NULL or zero episode numbers
issues.change: Use numbered identity only for positive episode numbers
issues.limits: Previously collapsed imports need an explicit repair mapping

issues.title: Failed file import batches left partial writes
issues.reproduction: Valid first file followed by vanished second file; include existing-row case
issues.change: Apply each file batch in one store transaction
issues.limits: Whole-import destination atomicity is now covered by LT-120; real foreign-server schemas and concurrent source mutation remain unverified

issues.title: Cancelled podcast EOF could publish incomplete audio
issues.reproduction: Reader cancels context while returning bytes with EOF
issues.change: Check cancellation after copy/close and before publication; retain retry eligibility

issues.title: Cancelled podcast work ingested data or delayed the next retry
issues.reproduction: Cancel before feed ingestion or during fetch
issues.change: Stop further ingestion/retention and avoid advancing last_fetch_at on cancellation

issues.title: Reader byte limits ran after unbounded allocation
issues.reproduction: Oversized streamed body or compressed page expands beyond configured cap
issues.change: Bound retained download/extraction chunks; cancel download and pause ZIP stream at first excess; refuse no-stream body fallback
issues.regression: readerResources.test.ts: real JSZip DEFLATE test plus cancellation/overflow cases
issues.limits: 512 MiB download / 256 MiB CBZ page byte policy; not an absolute heap, image-pixel, ZIP-directory or EPUB-internal-decompression bound

issues.title: CBZ navigation saved offscreen pages, retained stale jobs, or never finished even double spreads
issues.reproduction: Jump during extraction, close during decode, use webtoon keys, reach final spread in even-length book
issues.change: Cancel/drop superseded work, separate viewport and prefetch observation, scroll on webtoon keys, finish at last visible page

issues.title: EPUB iframe keybindings and async lifecycle were broken
issues.reproduction: Arrow/Escape inside iframe; close during hashing; index/navigation rejection
issues.change: Use forwarded epub.js keydown, reject late work, release resources, surface retryable navigation/index feedback and persist current CFI/percent
issues.limits: Typing targets remain excluded; no representative EPUB or real browser acceptance is claimed

issues.title: PDF resume controls disagreed with viewer or late metadata
issues.reproduction: Open finished book, switch edition, fail/delay metadata fetch or restore out-of-range page
issues.change: Key edition state, align finished restart at page 1, clamp pages, preserve saved position on failure, deadline/abort metadata and defer input until resolved
issues.limits: Native PDF viewer behavior remains real-browser unverified

issues.title: Search stale responses reopened dismissed UI or replaced newer results
issues.reproduction: Slow old query, then new query/clear/Escape/outside click/unmount
issues.change: Generations, immediate invalidation, cancellation and deadline-bound requests; refocus can restart dismissed search
issues.regression: searchLifecycle.test.tsx: six tests fail on baseline, seven pass after fix

issues.title: Secondary playlist/podcast players mixed sessions and lost revisit resume
issues.reproduction: Switch items then emit old media events; slow save during 1→2→1; revisit podcast before/after metadata; late playlist response; queue a progress write, then change the signed-in session before it drains
issues.change: Key media and detail sessions, pause/save outgoing element, ignore detached events, serialize same-token/endpoint writes across sessions, retain local podcast resume without overwriting pending restore; discard queued writes when the current session no longer matches their originating session
issues.regression: secondaryAudioSessions.test.tsx; secondaryAudioReview.test.tsx: six baseline failures plus four independent-review reproductions; queued-session-change regression (secondaryAudioSessions.test.tsx)
issues.limits: Durable offline storage and cross-device reconciliation remain open. Multipart playlist audio is now covered by LT-122

issues.title: Podcast/playlist HTTP failures rendered malformed or misleading empty/missing views
issues.reproduction: Return HTTP 503 error-shaped JSON for list/detail reads
issues.change: Validate response shapes and distinguish server failures from missing playlists

issues.title: Games downgrade left dangling work/playlist/scan-job foreign keys
issues.reproduction: Seed game work plus empty game work, mixed playlist and scan jobs, downgrade to 0010 then re-upgrade
issues.change: Delete unsupported dependencies in order before removing games libraries
issues.regression: migrations_roundtrip_test.go: broken FK reproduction, fixed downgrade; full empty cycle and populated 0001→0015 upgrade
issues.limits: Down migration already intentionally removes unsupported game data; do not downgrade a real database without a verified backup

issues.title: Container frontend build did not require the exact lockfile or typecheck
issues.reproduction: Docker recipe used npm install and only build
issues.change: Use npm ci and TypeScript before building web assets
issues.regression: Recipe inspected; equivalent locked frontend/typecheck/build runs in make test
issues.limits: Docker is not installed here; no container runtime validation

issues.title: Runtime-library watcher regression raced its unfinished fixture
issues.reproduction: Register a new library while the test is still writing its CBZ; initial reconciliation can correctly report an incomplete archive before later watch events retry
issues.change: Complete the runtime-add fixture before registering its library and explicitly wait for both initial and new watches; separately test partial-write failure followed by completed-file ingestion and shutdown
issues.regression: TestLibraryAddedAtRuntimeGetsWatched and TestPartialWriteIsRetriedAfterCompletion each pass 20 race-enabled repetitions
issues.limits: Test reliability repair; the separate regression confirms existing watcher retry behavior and does not claim all live filesystem timing cases are covered

issues.title: Late ABS and Kavita import failures left partial destination state
issues.source: internal/importer/abs.go; kavita.go; importer.go; internal/store transaction seams
issues.reproduction: Inject stage and commit failures after new/existing users, libraries, works, editions, files, reading/audio progress or playlists; replace a discovered file with a directory
issues.change: Apply all destination reads and writes through one transaction; share Tx query seams without nested file/playlist transactions; return no successful plan on failure
issues.regression: atomicity_test.go: 38 rollback cases fail before repair; importer/store suites and race pass; repeated/concurrent imports, single-connection routing, read-only source and dry-run controls
issues.limits: Closes LT-P03 for supported destination writes. Discovery is read-only but not a foreign-server snapshot; large-import writer-lock duration and real foreign schema/version acceptance remain unverified

issues.title: Primary audio progress writes overlapped, crossed sessions or lost completion
issues.reproduction: Delay a save then rewind/finish; return HTTP failure after completion/unmount; seek to zero; restart while an old completion retries; switch login or file before queued work drains
issues.change: Serialize endpoint writes in the originating login, bound requests, check HTTP results, retain failed in-tab completion with backoff, fence explicit/automatic restarts, preserve local edition resume and report exact outgoing file positions before new seek intent
issues.regression: primaryAudioProgress.test.tsx; audioProgressDelivery.test.ts; audio.test.tsx; audioReliabilityReview.test.tsx: five independent review reproductions plus slow writes, rewind/zero/restart, deadline, HTTP failure, replacement, local edition resume and originating-account coverage
issues.limits: In-tab retry only. No durable tab/process-loss queue, content generation, cross-device conflict protocol or exactly-once server ordering after ambiguous timeouts

issues.title: Playlist editions played only their first physical file
issues.reproduction: Play a two-file edition with resume in the second file, seek in either direction across the boundary, finish the first file and revisit an earlier item
issues.change: Load ordered file IDs/durations and progress from work detail; map cumulative positions to file-relative offsets; isolate detached file sessions and complete only the last file
issues.regression: multipartPlaylist.test.tsx: four failures on the preceding checkpoint pass after repair; existing secondary-audio regressions retained with realistic metadata events and work-detail fixtures
issues.limits: First-party direct audio only; multipart video/HLS/subtitles/thumbnails and live file-order changes remain open

issues.title: CBR cancellation left extractors running or published failed partial output
issues.reproduction: Cancel or expire the scan during unrar/unar extraction/listing; fail after partial cover bytes; cancel immediately before store publication
issues.change: Propagate caller context/deadline, unblock reads, kill/reap the launched process, reject failed partial output, clean temporary extraction and recheck cancellation before publication
issues.regression: cbr_cancellation_test.go: eight baseline subcases fail; cancellation, deadline, cleanup, partial-output and byte-cap controls pass under race and repetition
issues.limits: Synthetic extractors. Ongoing extraction-disk/process-tree budgets and real unrar/unar version compatibility remain separate

issues.title: Slow work detail responses replaced newer navigation
issues.reproduction: Navigate from a slow old work request to a newer work, then resolve the old response
issues.change: Key work and edition view sessions, abort old detail requests, guard results by generation and distinguish load errors
issues.regression: primaryAudioProgress.test.tsx stale-response regression fails before repair and passes afterward
issues.limits: Component tests; actual browser navigation and native media behavior remain acceptance gates

remaining.title: Physical source identity and existing data repair
remaining.evidence: Work/title keys still determine source identity; same-title editions, retags, alternate encodings and previously collapsed/wrong-root records need a deliberate migration. See source-identity-proposal.md.
remaining.next: Disposable real-library inventory; choose ownership schema; reviewable repair map; stable IDs/progress, rollback and every adapter acceptance

remaining.title: Content/order generations and derived assets
remaining.evidence: Sidecar fingerprints and thumbnail/trickplay/content generations remain incomplete; running clients can retain a pre-rescan queue.
remaining.next: Pause/reload before order-changing scans; define a generation-aware playback and invalidation contract

remaining.title: Durable offline media progress
remaining.evidence: Reader queue is durable and revision-aware. Primary/playlist audio now serialize and retry within the tab; audio/video/podcast saves still do not share a durable, complete media conflict protocol.
remaining.next: Specify intent-aware restart/seek/completion conflicts and content generations, then persist user-scoped operations and test disconnect/reload/cross-device conflicts; see media-consistency-proposal.md

remaining.title: Multipart video, HLS and derived timelines
remaining.evidence: Playlist direct-audio editions now use ordered files and cumulative offsets (LT-122). Video playback and thumbnail/HLS paths still select the first file.
remaining.next: Selected-file plus generation/cumulative-offset contract across server, player, resume, chapters, subtitles, thumbnails and adapters; see media-consistency-proposal.md

remaining.title: Broader archive/decode/transcode budgets
remaining.evidence: CBR cancellation/reaping/cleanup is repaired, but streamed byte caps still do not bound browser decoded pixels/aggregate cache, EPUB internals, ZIP directory parsing, ongoing unar extraction disk, or total HLS disk.
remaining.next: Measure representative long media and archives; define non-breaking memory/disk quotas with cleanup/seek tests

remaining.title: Runtime dependency gate
remaining.evidence: Existing epubjs/xmldom and devalue dependency paths were previously reported by npm audit. They were not upgraded or newly security-audited in this pass.
remaining.next: Representative EPUB CFI/restore/navigation corpus before a breaking dependency change; coordinate with existing dependency update PRs rather than duplicating or blindly upgrading them; rerun the dependency gate only under permitted coverage

remaining.title: Real library, browser and compatibility corpus
remaining.evidence: No Gate W founder week, real-device browser playback, native PDF or live ABS/Jellyfin/OPDS acceptance. ABS corpus contains only one ping fixture; Jellyfin corpus is absent.
remaining.next: Backed-up disposable library; representative EPUB/CBZ/PDF/audio/video; live-client capture and bidirectional progress checks

remaining.evidence: Excluded by the prior platform restriction; not retried or reconstructed. Existing automated suites ran, but this is not an independent security assessment.
remaining.next: Only pursue through an authorized supported review route; no inference of security completeness

remaining.evidence: No Docker runtime, live deployment, hardware encoder, real unrar/unar implementation, representative long-play disk budget or production-scale benchmark was exercised. CBR cancellation uses synthetic extractors.
remaining.next: Run container/service smoke, native-target runs, hwaccel/CBR checks and representative resource measurements before release
